ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Feb-19-2004 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for OSC hearing for Change of Name of a minor.
Commissioner Sue Kaplan, Clerk: S. Ravinantapricha, CSR: Leticia Perez.
Petitioners: Joanne Cui present in pro per for the minor, were sworn and examined.
The Order Dispending Notice to the minor's biological father was granted.
The Court grants the petition for change of the MINOR'S name to: Emily Ying Xin Cui
Decree signed in open court.

ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Dec-23-2003 Reset To Feb-19-04 At 09:00 A.M. In Dept 218 For Order To Show Cause
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for OSC hearing for Change of Name of a minor.
Commissioner Sue Kaplan, Clerks: S. Ravinantapricha/M. Vallejo, CSR: Janet Pond.
Petitioner Joanne Cui present in pro per, was sworn and examined.
Lacks the minor father's signature on the petition, this matter is continued to Feb. 19,2004 at 09:00 a.m. in Dept. 218 for appearance of the minor's father.
